title: Amazon QuickSight Bulk Export and Download Audit
app: Amazon QuickSight CloudTrail events via the Splunk Add-on for AWS and the QuickSight API via HEC.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=aws:cloudtrail (eventName="*Export*" OR eventName="GenerateEmbedUrl*")
| stats count as exports, sum(coalesce(row_count,rows,record_count)) as rows by userIdentity.arn
| eventstats avg(rows) as avg_rows, stdev(rows) as sd_rows
| where rows>avg_rows+3*sd_rows
| sort - rows
description: Watches Amazon QuickSight for users exporting or downloading unusually large volumes of data, a signal for both data-exfiltration risk and ungoverned spreadsheet sprawl.
value: Large exports move governed data out of Amazon QuickSight where it can no longer be controlled; anomaly detection flags the risky ones for review.
implementation: Ingest Amazon QuickSight export/download events with row counts; schedule daily and alert on 3-sigma export-volume anomalies per user.
visualization: Table of user by export volume, anomaly markers.
grandmaExplanation: We notice when someone pulls an unusually large amount of data out of Amazon QuickSight so it can be checked.
